spec.expr:
sum by(instance) (rate(apiserver_request_total{code=~"5..", cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
 / (sum by(instance) (rate(apiserver_request_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

sum by(verb) (rate(apiserver_request_total{code=~"5..", cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
 / (sum by(verb) (rate(apiserver_request_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)
